messages.subject: error message in multilevel SEM
parts:
Hello,

I've seen a few posts about this, but I haven't seen any clear answers and I am wondering if there have been any updates on this. I am trying to run (what seems like) a simple multilevel SEM and I keep getting an error that I do not understand. Here's the basic structure of my model:

mlsem <-'
level: 1
    XW =~ X1 + X2 + X3
    MW =~ M1 + M2 + M3
    YW =~ Y1 + Y2 + Y3
    MW ~ XW
    YW ~ MW + XW
level: 2

    XB =~ X1 + X2 + X3
    MB =~ M1 + M2 + M3
    YB =~ Y1 + Y2 + Y3
    MB ~ XB
    YB ~ MB + XB

'

When I try to run
    fit2<- sem(mlsem, data=data, cluster="ï..ID")
    summary(fit1, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized=T,rsquare=T)
I get an error that says "Error in if (fx.delta < tol) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"

What does this mean? Does my model seem to be okay, or is there something wrong in my model specification that is producing this error?

Any advice would be so appreciated! Please let me know if I can provide any additional info.

--------------------------------
Allycen R. Kurup, B.S.
pronouns: she/her/hers
Clinical Psychology Graduate Student
Purdue University
